messages.subject: Your witness statement - commissioning and the joint inspection
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

We're preparing factual witness statements for the February exchange. Yours will cover the commissioning programme, the abnormal behaviour you saw on String B, the suspension decision and the joint site inspection on 3 December. I've attached a list of the documents we'll refer to (the test logs, the BMS export and your inspection note). Could we have 45 minutes on Thursday to take you through a first draft?

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Your witness statement - commissioning and the joint inspection
messages.plaintextBody:
Thursday after 2pm works. Just to flag - at the 3 December inspection Calderhall's engineer effectively conceded the behaviour was abnormal but kept saying it 'must be integration'. I made a contemporaneous note. Happy to walk you through it.

Tom Pryce | Head of Engineering | Verdant Energy Systems
